items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: the Ray Bolton baseball players, before the Crescent Stalk Park was put up, they would play on the greens with the kids.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. What kind of, uh, ball games did you play? They must have been not just baseball.

No, well, we had stick ball. You had stick ball. Stick ball. You hit, you hit your stick, your baseball bat might have been an old broom handle. Mm-hmm. Hit the ball, you run the first base, you had first, second and third base. Then sometimes as the, as the times went by, we would go out into the greens, which we used to call back of town. Back of town, back around St. Norton and Johnson, all those were big green lights. Mm-hmm. And a lot of the, a lot of the old baseball players, the Ray Bolton baseball…
Mm-hmm. They, they got a kick out of them.
